contract: A captured args dependency change aborts the run, resets to initial, re-evaluates args and restarts (switchMap); coalesced per tick; done / error streams restart too; getters in args work; chains are legitimate; self-dependency is an error; mutual cycles MUST NOT (undetected).
signals: limitation: mutual cycles are not detected
no occurrence-only restart command - bump a generation counter

contract: none
Infinite streams MUST use a bounded fold; raw accumulation is for finite streams only.

section: ### Return a New Value (No In-Place Mutation)
contract: fold must return a fresh value; in-place mutation defeats the same-value guard and list diffing.
fold runs once per chunk; DOM reflection follows microtask batching (in practice one drain per chunk); equal primitive chunks are skipped by the same-value guard; there is no built-in throttling.
signals: overlap: throttling is delegated to the <wcs-debounce> / <wcs-throttle> I/O nodes

contract: Eager start after $connectedCallback; abort + idle on disconnect; restart from initial on reconnect (no resume); a re-set aborts and restarts once; SSR never starts streams.
signals: doc-staleness: 'another state element with the same name' - v1 named states were removed in v2

contract: Not supported: wildcard / dotted names and wildcard args reads, async fold, Observable sources, auto-reconnect, lazy start (reserved), per-binding lifetimes, $stream on a DCC definition element, backpressure.
signals: limitation: known edge - removing a stream declaration on re-set leaves bindings to its status / error showing stale values
reserved: `lazy: true` not implemented
